name: chart-rises
subject: A person in profile stands beside a big loose computer screen with a bar chart of three bars. Panel 1: no bars. Bars grow a little taller each panel. Panel 9: bars tall, the person raises one fist. Panels 2 to 8 are smooth in-betweens.

name: coffee-ripples
subject: A tiny person relaxes on the right side of a big coffee cup, head, shoulders and one arm on the rim, same place and pose in all nine panels. Only ripples on the coffee and two steam curls move a little from panel to panel.

name: page-turn
subject: A person sits on a stack of books reading an open book, body still in every panel. Panel 1: book flat. Panels 2 to 8: one page lifts, stands upright at panel 5 and lands on the other side. Panel 9: book flat again.

name: gift-give
subject: A person in profile holds a small gift box with a bow, in every panel. Panel 1: box against the chest. The arms move forward a little more each panel. Panel 9: arms stretched out offering the box, small smile. Panels 2 to 8 are smooth in-betweens.

name: laces-tie
subject: Only a pair of sneakers on the ground, no person. Panel 1: laces loose. Panel 3: laces crossed. Panel 5: one loop. Panel 7: second loop. Panel 9: a neat bow tied. Smooth in-betweens.

name: thinker
subject: A person sits on a low block in profile. Panel 1: upright, hands on knees. Leaning forward a little more each panel. Panel 9: elbow on the knee, chin on the fist, deep in thought like the thinker statue. Panels 2 to 8 are smooth in-betweens.

name: run
subject: A person drawn in outline only, body never filled, runs toward the right in profile, leaning forward, on one baseline. Nine panels of one run cycle: legs and arms clearly alternate, one foot in the air, then the other, ending where it began.

name: door-open
subject: Fixed camera. A tall plain door from the floor to above the head; beside it a whole person in profile, head to feet standing on the floor line, holding the round knob. Panel 1: door closed. The door swings open a little more each panel. Panel 9: wide open, the opening left white.

name: camera-flash
subject: A person in profile holds a camera to the eye, nobody else. Panels 1 to 3: aiming, still. Panel 4: finger presses. Panels 5 to 7: a coral watercolor flash burst in front of the camera grows then fades. Panels 8 and 9: aiming again. Coral only on the flash.

name: sofa-typing
subject: Close-up of two hands typing on a laptop keyboard resting on knees, outline only. Same framing in all nine panels; only the fingers move, a different finger pressing a key in each panel, like fast typing.

name: accordion
subject: A standing person in profile plays an accordion. Nine panels of one cycle: bellows closed, opening wider each panel to wide open at panel 5 with the head tilted back, then closing again by panel 9.

name: yoga
subject: A person drawn in outline only, never filled, does yoga on a mat. Panel 1: standing, palms together. Panel 3: arms raised high. Panel 5: tree pose. Panel 7: arms opening. Panel 9: warrior pose, arms wide. Smooth in-betweens.

name: suitcase-run
subject: A person drawn in outline only runs toward the right pulling a rolling suitcase. Nine panels of one run cycle on one baseline: legs clearly alternate, back foot pushing, front foot reaching, arms swinging, the suitcase bouncing.

name: envelope-open
subject: Two hands drawn in outline only hold an envelope, nobody else. Panel 1: closed. Panels 2 to 4: the flap lifts. Panels 5 to 8: a letter marked with a big @ slides out a little more each panel. Panel 9: the letter fully out.

name: checklist-tick
subject: A sheet with three wavy lines, each with a box, and a hand holding a pen. A tick once drawn stays in every later panel. Panel 1: all empty. Panel 3: first box ticked. Panel 6: second ticked too. Panel 8: all three ticked. Panel 9: pen lifted. Smooth in-betweens.

name: snow-globe
subject: Only a snow globe on a simple base with a small mountain inside, no person. Same globe in all nine panels; small snowflake dots fall slowly, a little lower each panel, new ones appearing at the top.

name: card-pay
subject: A hand holds a bank card above a small loose payment terminal. Panel 1: card high above. Panel 4: card touches the terminal. Panels 5 to 7: one, two, three dots appear on its small screen. Panel 9: a big check mark on the screen, card lifted. Smooth in-betweens.

name: coffee-sip
subject: A person in profile sits at a desk with a laptop, a coffee cup beside. Panel 1: typing. Panel 3: hand on the cup. Panel 5: cup at the mouth, sipping. Panel 7: cup back on the desk. Panel 9: typing again. Other panels are smooth in-betweens.

name: fever
subject: A person in profile holds a phone to the ear, tired; a big loose thermometer beside. Coral watercolor only inside the thermometer, a little higher each panel: panel 1 empty bulb, panel 9 full, head drooping a little. Panels 2 to 8 are smooth in-betweens.

name: binoculars
subject: A person in profile holds binoculars in both hands in every panel; they never vanish. Panel 1: binoculars at the eyes. Panels 2 to 4: lowering them. Panel 5: at the chest, eye open. Panel 6: eye closed, a blink. Panel 7: eye open. Panels 8 and 9: raising them back.
